name: Station stairwell entrance (railed stairs + support pillar + tactile platform edge)

anchor.note: dx/dy below are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the stairwell descends toward dy+ (south/away from viewer).

offset_basis_summary: Stairs_Complete_1 is already a single pre-composed multi-tile Single (railing + steps baked into one cutout), so it needs no internal offsets. The support pillar and the tactile platform-edge tiles live in unrelated rows on the Subway sheet, so their placement here is hand-authored to form a plausible station-entrance composition: safety tiles mark the top edge, the stairs descend below, and a structural pillar anchors one side.

pieces.notes: Tactile hazard strip along the top edge of the stairwell opening; repeat horizontally to span the full stair width.
Turns the tactile strip along the pillar side to close the hazard border.
Single pre-composed Single (railings + steps baked in); already spans 3x5 tiles by itself.
Structural column beside the stairwell opening, same height as the stair unit.
Optional far-side pillar for a symmetric double-column entrance; omit for a narrower footprint.

variants.stairwell_style: Swap stairwell piece for stairs_complete_2/3/4 (me.subway.stairs_complete_2/3/4) for a different rail/step skin, or for the me.subway.stairs_modular_set pieces (Stairs_Structure_1/2 + Stairs_1-3 + Stairs_Railing_1-2 + Stairs_Base_Structure_2) to hand-build a custom-length staircase.
variants.pillar_count: secondary_pillar is optional; drop it for a single-column entrance against a wall.

notes: me.subway.stairs_modular_set (rank 45 in group-candidates.json) is the mechanically-detected sibling candidate for this scene; this authored example widens it into a full entrance composition with a support pillar and tactile safety edge, matching how these props read together on real station facades.
